source_followup_drafts.title: Resolve billietite surface-study salt and specimen-caption discrepancies
source_followup_drafts.body: The scoped billietite record retains discrepancies in Schindler et al.2007 DOI10.2113/gscanmin.45.4.945: Table1 lists BaCl2 while methods/Figure5 describe CaCl2; Figure7 names becquerelite where surrounding text concerns billietite. The record excludes those ambiguous arms. Acquire a publisher correction, author clarification or underlying experiment/image metadata by an authorized route; identify the exact salt and specimen for each disputed panel; preserve original and successor provenance. Do not silently repair labels or infer quantitative bulk dissolution from AFM relief. Acceptance: independently review any supported record extension against clarified primary evidence, retain unresolved uncertainties and save native review. No claim that a correction exists.

source_followup_drafts.title: Reconcile compreignacite2017 source versions, solid-composition discrepancies and model chemistry
source_followup_drafts.body: The record uses the complete OSTI1349074 accepted manuscript and publisher17page SI for DOI10.1016/j.gca.2017.03.009. Section3.2.2 associates about76 micromol/g solid U with high-carbonate K treatment, whereas Table3 assigns75.9 to low and16.2 to high; Section4.2 calls K material K-deficient despite U:K2.13. SI TableS3 uses7waters versus main8, and contains chemistry transcription concerns (MgSO4 dissociation lists Ca; uranyl-carbonate charge/sign entries warrant checking against the actual model database). No model rerun is claimed. Acquire the final typeset article and any correction/model input by a legitimate route; compare versions and establish correct sample/assay mapping and actual code chemistry before inferring additional yields or intrinsic rates. Acceptance: retain original artifacts, document exact discrepancies and resolutions, independently review any extensions; measured Table2 column mass balance must remain distinct from fitted Table6 rates and from final-solid assays.
